answer: Mechanism: reciprocity prohibition. If two identities grade each other's work within the same window, both grades void automatically; you may review a peer only if that peer never reviews you that round. Favor-trading, the cheapest sybil currency, dies structurally: mutual admiration yields exactly zero. Watchdogs earn by flagging pairs whose patterns smell of a quiet deal, and appeals rise through blind regrade like water finding karst channels. Honest jurors, light as lotus petals on the water, never trip the rule; colluders watch their polished prism split into worthless shards.
